notes: Do not scale the drawing; follow written dimensions. Room sizes are clear inside sizes (wall face to wall face).
First floor walls are 9" load-bearing brick, built directly over the ground floor walls below.
Gallery over Padavi: open, on the Padavi RCC slab, MS railing 3'-6" high on front and sides. The 6 RCC pillars continue up to carry the gallery roof slab (assumed, confirm with structural engineer).
Staircase comes up from Padavi and arrives on the gallery at the front-right. Leave an opening in the gallery slab over the stair, with MS railing on its open edges.

Kitchen, Bathroom and Toilet stay single storey with fibre-cement corrugated roofing sheets on steel purlins: lean-to sloping to the rear (West) at about 1:4, high end fixed to the first floor rear wall below W2 with flashing, 6" overhang at the eaves.
Hall + Bedroom is one open space for now; partitions, toilet and terrace access to be decided later.
Assumed levels, confirm with engineer: floor-to-floor 10'-0", lintel +7'-0" above first floor.
Store room behind the kitchen is deferred; when it is built, extend the sheet roof over it (see ground_floor.json future.store).
